question: Related Questions Q. About dovorce 5045 views Q. talaq 1692 views Q. if someone says his wife talaq 3 times at the same time out of anger and frustaration due to her daliverate mis-behaivior, will talaq be count as 3 or 1 or not at all? Both husband and wife want to continue the relationship and they have 2 children. 2327 views Q. asalualikum,respected mufti sahib,my sister got married 2 years back,her husband always force her to get money from us for his personal habits(consuming alchol),due to this he has sold some of her jewels . we talked to his parents they say its an emotional out burst & SOCIAL HABIT,and asked us to ignore it,now my sister feels that she cant live with him so we approched quazi shaib in our town,for a khula,but her husband say he still wants to live with her in front of the qazi,sir, can you please help us to get a khula with out his signature since the qazi refuse to end the marriage with out his signature , we have already retured his MAHAR. 2230 views Q. At first time i with the intention of rajaee said a talla and not pronounced complete words just tallaa and stopped and feared said my wife to go her home and i will get referred about this matter after a weak i found that if any one said one tallaq with the niyyat of rajaee the nikah never collapses then i forgot about that but after some days gone when she planned to escape and put me in trouble i used to say that MY TUJHE EK TALLAQ DERAHA HU at that time the first situation in which i not completed total words of tallaq is not in my knowledge.i get connected with moulana and he said if a person says two tallaqs with the niyyat of rajaeee nikah never collapsed. after rajaee i said her if you go home with out permission the other two tallaq will occur TUM GHAR CHALE GAYE AB THO AUR DO TALLAQ. in this situation i only warned her and not used two times the words. she then requested me and i took her to her home. now she saying that two tallaqs occured and to forget her i used to myself that imagine that she had given three tallaqs. if i myself says is tallaq occurs please guide me in rightious way. 2756 views Q. One of my friends is in a state of confusion regarding HAQ-e-Mahar. 3 years back he has done his NIKAH with a girl in his relation and he went to abroad for his studies. There was no RUKSATI and the girl was still living at her home. In the mean time the girl lost interest in my friend and she gave the reason that he is very conservative and religious. She was asking again and again for Talaq. In spite of a lot of negotiations from both families this relation was failed and finally last week my friend gave her Talaq on phone and in written. Now the question is, as I stated before there was no RUKSATI took place. Only NIKAH was done. The girl is un-touched. So, the boy have to pay HAQ-e-Mahar or not? 1842 views Q. I said once to my wife (when we were married newly) that you are like my mother, just as I got 2nd mother 2538 views Q. my question is in regard of fatwa id:8028, if a woman gets khula when she is pregnant with a child after commiting adultery is that khula is valid, and is that child is illegal even after delivery that woman and the man who commit adultery repents to allah and get married, please answer this question in the light of shariah. Is there any punishment for them? 1912 views Q. Question regarding validity of Talaaq and Ruju after khula/talaq. 13022 views Q. Divorce during pregnancy? 35674 views Q. Assalam-Alaikum - My wife has forcefully obtained a Khula without my consent through an Imam in the USA. She has not informed any genuine reasons to the Imam, who claims that it is permissible to grant her the Khula without a reason or husband's consent. For the sake of obtaining the Khula, she came up with some false allegations against me that the Imam did not verify with me but agreed with her. She has been studying at a different city and denied me access to her during the last one year. Hence I was not given any chance of reconciliation by my wife. She has also taken away jewelry that my family had purchased for her use but as my wife. Being a only child, she has been offered unconditional support of her parents, who claim that I have spoiled their daughter's life, which is not the case. Our marriage was not 100% in order as we both expected to live in two cities and meet often to support my job and her studies. Is this Khula permitted? Can my wife take away the jewelry? Should the reasons of the Khula be shared with the husband for mutual agreement? Is the husband's consent not required at all? I am afraid that such exploitation of Islam is harmful to the institution of marriage. When asked about it, the Imam said that men also abuse their rights. This was not a good answer. Please let me know if this Khula is valid or can be revoked. I really love my wife and do not have any issues with her. I am willing to give her anything to maintain the marriage. What is the solution for this problem? Kindly respond as soon as possible as I am really worried. Jazak-Allah. 20728 views Q. Talaq 1516 views Q. I want to know the rules of divorce 2240 views Q. Regarding Iddah 2597 views Q. I need your help and guidance in clarifying a divorce matter. My friend's husband pronounced her 9 times on phone that 'I DIVORCE YOU' 1745 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 64642 Country: India Title: Single Talaq Question: I pronounced one talaq to my wife and let her stay at my home till her iddah period. She suffers from Psychiatric problems and her parents are against her treatment. They interfere a lot in my marital life. After seven years of harassment, in the interest of my two kids, I felt it would be best to give her one talaq so that they would fall in line and accept for her treatment and also stop interfering in my life. I have medical certificates proving the same. I told them that if you accept my conditions I'm willing to reconcile. But my mother-in-law in order to not let us reconcile came to my house and stayed at house for two and a half months. Later she took her daughter (my wife) away with her before the completion of Iddah period. I wasn't able to reconcile. Now it's been one year. But my kids are very much attached to me and they are being ill treated at their mom's place. I'm only meeting my kids at their school as my ex in-laws are not allowing me to meet them. Now for the sake of kids I want to take back my wife only for the sake of the welfare of the children. Now my questions are (1) How many talaqs have occurred, one or two? (2) Can I make nikah with her again? Answer ID: 64642 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 749/746/L=07/1437) If you have given only one talaq then you may take your wife back in your nikah by doing a fresh nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
